utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Thursday the twenty-sixth. Everyone on? I've got seven little boxes and about three ceilings.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, here. Honestly, the traffic on the ring road. Barely moved for twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You're moving now, though. Your camera's making me seasick.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry! There. Was hoping to get out walking at the weekend, but the weather looks absolutely grim. Anyone got better plans?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Staying indoors. Been training for it all winter.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Oh, and there's a birthday cake in the office. Before we get buried in all this.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Finally, a useful production update.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cake duly noted. Finished stuff first, then what we're actually taking on.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We tested the HV switchboard yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done, not something for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the closed item. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the wrapper last night. That repair's complete.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. But we've got a jam on it this morning. Separate from what you repaired?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. The repaired bit's fine. It's the jam and the sensor state we're talking about now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. Just wanted it clear we weren't reopening last night's repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. New jam, separate job. I've got it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're saying wrapper — I noticed the stretch wrapper was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Different thing from this jam, then? Don't want those getting muddled.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. It settled down, no new job coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: heard a slight rattle from the GT2 water valve. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only, not an extra job for you.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm still blocked on the turbine one gas valve. Can't get to it until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked. We're not pretending it's booked in.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 1 TCU. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery hiding in the paperwork, either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. That's a blocker update, not a fresh delivery promise.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Um, on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve, I'll replace the seals. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. Replacement of the seals on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve is yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that. Definitely one for the actual work list, not the closed stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you do the pre-use checks on the forklifts by end of day? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that as well. I haven't got the capacity, and I don't want to say yes and leave them sitting there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Tom, can you take the pre-use checks on the forklifts instead? Same thing: by end of day, but that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take them. Pre-use checks on the forklifts first for me, done by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And obviously they don't go into use unchecked. End of day isn't permission to run them before the checks.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, absolutely. That's why I'm putting them first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you also chase the purchase order for the wrapper today? Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The purchase order, yeah? Not the unconfirmed delivery we were just talking about?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, just chase the purchase order for the wrapper. Separate from the line 1 TCU blocker. Today, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Got you. I'll chase the purchase order for the wrapper today, lower down than the forklifts.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, two different bits of paperwork. Easy enough to cross the wires with all these names.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one. Olumide Adeyemi, can you schedule downtime for line one with production first thing tomorrow? Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't own that one either, sorry. Same capacity problem. Better to hand it over than have me half agree.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Grace, can you take that instead — schedule downtime for line one with production first thing tomorrow? It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll schedule downtime for line one with production first thing tomorrow. Fairly important, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there — first thing tomorrow is when you're doing the scheduling, not saying the line's going down then?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Correct. That's when I'll do the scheduling with production. We haven't agreed an actual downtime slot here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you run the monthly fire alarm test first thing tomorrow? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test first thing tomorrow. Not an urgent one for today, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Monthly already. February's about six minutes long.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Still manages to fit a full month's paperwork in, somehow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: One more from me. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the water booster after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie Brennan. Water booster lock-out tag-out sign-off, after lunch — you've got that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. After lunch.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just keeping the wording straight — sign-off, not us agreeing a restart on this call.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. I'm taking the lock-out tag-out sign-off, not adding a restart.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. For me, the wrapper jam and sensors are the drop-everything job. Tom's got the production hold-up first on his side.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep. Forklifts first, by end of day. Purchase order for the wrapper today as well, but low priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I've got scheduling with production for line one first thing tomorrow. Nothing extra from the warm-running observation.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Monthly fire alarm test first thing tomorrow for me as well. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the line 1 TCU delivery is still unconfirmed. No change on that during this call.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same for the turbine one gas valve — still waiting on a production window, not a commitment for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's the agreed list, no extras smuggled in. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Only cake smuggled in. Although judging by the office, it won't survive very long.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's not a blocker. That's a forecast. Cheers, all.
